chunks.text: Northwind Fabrication grants access to the CUI enclave only through accounts in the corp.northwind.local Active Directory domain. Each account request is filed as a ServiceNow ticket and approved by the requester's manager and the IT Security Lead before creation.

Only devices enrolled in Microsoft Intune with a compliant status can join the CUI VLAN (VLAN 40).
svc_erp runs the Epicor ERP integration. svc_backup runs Veeam backup jobs. Service accounts are reviewed every 90 days by the IT Security Lead.
All remote access to Northwind systems goes through the Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN. GlobalProtect requires Duo push or a YubiKey 5 hardware token in addition to the AD password.

Domain administrators sign in to the jump host NW-JMP-01 with a smart card (PIV) and PIN. Local network logons to servers by privileged accounts require Duo MFA through the Duo Authentication for Windows Logon agent, version 4.3.

Windows security event logs, firewall logs from the two Palo Alto PA-440 firewalls, and Microsoft 365 unified audit logs forward to the Splunk Cloud instance. Logs are retained for 13 months, with the most recent 90 days searchable.

Before disposal or reuse, hard drives that stored CUI are wiped with Blancco Drive Eraser using the NIST 800-88 Purge method. Drives that fail the wipe are physically shredded by Shred-It on site.
